items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah that's when I first met Frankie Lymon. We were on the same little TV thing he made -- a little film.

ctx.x: glad to be there. I guess if he had wanted me to play, he'd have, you know.
How was it that you got there, was it through Stanley Dance?

Yeah, because I was invited to play at a place in somewhere in the Bronx they were playing, and I went up there to see him. And first thing he said, hey I thought you were gonna bring your guitar. But I don't know. How the hell do I know. I'm goin' to see him and they playin' the band is playin' he was inside but the band was playin'. And like it was a concert up there. And nobody said nothin'. I ain't the type of guy to be boastrous. What the hell did I say, What the hell I look like, little as I am goin' in…
